mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_accounting_instruction (id, ledger_book_id, instruction_type, origin_type, source_system, source_event_key, source_version, source_payload_hash, transaction_economics_id, manual_adjustment_id, accounting_rule_bundle_ver_id, input_hash, status, maker_id, checker_id, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{ledgerBookId}, #{instructionType}, #{originType}, #{sourceSystem}, #{sourceEventKey}, #{sourceVersion}, #{sourcePayloadHash}, #{transactionEconomicsId}, #{manualAdjustmentId}, #{accountingRuleBundleVerId}, #{inputHash}, #{status}, #{makerId}, #{checkerId}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, ledger_book_id, instruction_type, origin_type, source_system, source_event_key, source_version, source_payload_hash, transaction_economics_id, manual_adjustment_id, accounting_rule_bundle_ver_id, input_hash, status, maker_id, checker_id, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_accounting_instruction WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, ledger_book_id, instruction_type, origin_type, source_system, source_event_key, source_version, source_payload_hash, transaction_economics_id, manual_adjustment_id, accounting_rule_bundle_ver_id, input_hash, status, maker_id, checker_id, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_accounting_instruction WHERE manual_adjustment_id = #{manualAdjustmentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_accounting_instruction SET status = #{status}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{instruction.id} AND status = #{instruction.status} AND version = #{instruction.version}
mapper.select: SELECT id, ledger_book_id, instruction_type, origin_type, source_system, source_event_key, source_version, source_payload_hash, transaction_economics_id, manual_adjustment_id, accounting_rule_bundle_ver_id, input_hash, status, maker_id, checker_id, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_accounting_instruction WHERE transaction_economics_id = #{transactionEconomicsId} AND origin_type = 'AUTO' ORDER BY ledger_book_id, id
